definitions.gloss: inexperienced; having no experience; no prior experience
definitions.explanation: Having no prior experience in a particular field, job, or activity. Very commonly seen in job listings to indicate that applicants without experience are welcome.

examples.japanese: ⟦{未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}→未経験者：26291_mikeikensha⟧⟦{歓迎|かんげい}→歓迎：02557_kangei⟧。
examples.english: No experience necessary. (lit. Inexperienced persons welcome.)

examples.japanese: ⟦プログラミング→プログラミング：06099_puroguramingu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未経験|みけいけん}です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}して→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧みたいです。
examples.english: I have no programming experience, but I'd like to give it a try.

examples.japanese: {未経験|みけいけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}む→飛び込む：04614_tobikomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧だ。
examples.english: Jumping into an unfamiliar field is nerve-wracking, but it's a good opportunity to learn new things.

notes:
USAGE:
{未経験|みけいけん} uses the prefix ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ (not yet), indicating a state of not having done something. Very commonly seen in job advertisements: ⟦{未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}→未経験者：26291_mikeikensha⟧⟦{歓迎|かんげい}→歓迎：02557_kangei⟧ or {未経験|みけいけん}OK.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}→未経験者：26291_mikeikensha⟧ (inexperienced person)
- ⟦{未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}→未経験者：26291_mikeikensha⟧⟦{歓迎|かんげい}→歓迎：02557_kangei⟧ (no experience necessary)
- ⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧{未経験|みけいけん} (no industry experience)
- {未経験|みけいけん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{始|はじ}める (to start with no experience)
